description: The key under which a nested parse's answer is remembered must tell every field of every token apart, even when a token's phonemes hold characters that a key might use as separators: the two pairs here differ only in how their phonemes split between the tokens (engine §4, nested parses).
grammar:
%rule text $x(pair) $y(pair)
%conditions matches($x, probe), ¬matches($y, probe)
%rule pair W W
%rule probe $f(W) W
%conditions phonemes($f) = "x"
